label: The MIRROR_2 image of the actual world has the opposite handedness
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: the feature H (global spatial handedness) holds at the CPT image τ.image w (MIRROR_2) exactly when it fails at w. The CPT image is a different arrangement. CPT conjugation reverses spatial handedness (as spatial reflection P also does). A relationalist about orientation who identifies a world with its global mirror image (σ w = w) denies it; so does anyone for whom global handedness is no feature of a world.
